S100FC:S100_FC_FeatureCatalogue.S100FC:name: Additional Military Layers
S100FC:S100_FC_FeatureCatalogue.S100FC:scope: Specialist maritime geospatial information for Defence.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Elevation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The altitude of the ground level of a feature, measured from a specified vertical datum.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Burial Probability
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The likelihood of subsequent burial and its estimated rate.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Source ID
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A unique identifier assigned to the source for reference and tracking purposes.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Completeness
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates whether the feature content has throughrougly included all criteria present in product specification.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Complete
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The area specified has been populated for all known features. Absence of features indicates that there are no such entities available to the data producer.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Partial
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Certain features have not been included (or only partially included) within the specified area. Details must be provided in supporting textual information.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vessels Characteristics
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Characteristics of vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Length Overall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The maximum length of the ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Length at Waterline
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The ship's length measured at the waterline.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breadth
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The width or beam of the vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Draught
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth of water necessary to float a vessel fully loaded.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Displacement Tonnage
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A measurement of the weight of the vessel, usually used for warships. (Merchant ships are usually measured based on the volume of cargo space; see tonnage). Displacement is expressed either in long tons of 2,240 pounds or metric tonnes of 1,000 kg. Since the two units are very close in size (2,240 pounds = 1,016 kg and 1,000 kg = 2,205 pounds), it is common not to distinguish between them. To preserve secrecy, nations sometimes misstate a warship's displacement.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gross Tonnage
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The entire internal cubic capacity of the ship expressed in tons of 100 cubic feet to the ton, except certain spaces with are exempted such as: peak and other tanks for water ballast, open forecastle bridge and poop, access of hatchways, certain light and air spaces, domes of skylights, condenser, anchor gear, steering gear, wheel house, galley and cabin for passengers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Net Tonnage
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Obtained from the gross tonnage by deducting crew and navigating spaces and allowances for propulsion machinery.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Attribute Total Concentration
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Specifies the concentration for all stages of development of ice in an area ('Ct').

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Free
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Water surface completely free of ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Open Water (1/10 Ice)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large area of freely navigable water in which sea ice is present in concentrations less than 1/10 and ice of land origin is absent.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bergy Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large area of navigable water in which ice of land origin is present or possible at a total concentration less than 1/10.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Source Type
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Type of the source.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Number of Features
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The number of features of identical character that exist as a co-located group.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Iceberg Form
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Specifies the prevailing form of icebergs in an area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Domed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mass of ice which is smooth and rounded on top.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tabular
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A flat-topped iceberg. Most tabular bergs form by calving from an ice shelf and show horizontal banding.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sloping
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ground that forms a natural or artificial incline.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pinnacled
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An iceberg weathered in such manner as to produce spires or pinnacles. Also called pyramidal iceberg, irregular iceberg.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dry-Dock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An iceberg which is eroded such that a U-shaped slot is formed near or at water level, with twin columns or pinnacles. This is also referred to as a twinned iceberg.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Glacier (Irregular)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An irregularly shaped iceberg.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Blocky
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The cryostructure in which horizontal and vertical ice veins form a three-dimensional, irregular rectangular lattice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Weathered
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An iceberg that shows marked signs of deterioration from the effects of atmosphere and ocean.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Scale Value Minimum
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The smallest scale for the range of survey scale.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Line Spacing Maximum
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximum distance between hydrographic survey lines.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Object Sensor
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates by the use of which sensor the object was reported.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Acoustic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a sound signal being returned from the SBO.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Magnetic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: the object was reported as a result of detecting a fluctuation in the local magnetic field.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Video Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a sighting through electronic visual equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by a person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Physical Snag
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of the object fouling lines, anchors or fishing nets.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Observed Sinking
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a first hand observation of the object sinking.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reported Sinking
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a report made by a third party or from published information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: None Reported
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The method by which the object was found was not reported.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Debris Field
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The length and orientation of the longest dimension of the debris field associated with the object.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Lead Status
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the surface nature of the lead.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Open Lead
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A lead that connects two open bodies of water; ships can traverse between them through this lead; it also refers to a lead where open water is found, or a lead that has not completely frozen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Frozen Lead
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A more than 50 metre wide rectilinear or wedge-shaped crack from several kilometres to several hundreds of kilometres in length, within which new, nilas and young ice has formed at the surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Signal Duration
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The time occupied by a single instance of light/sound or eclipse/silence in a signal sequence.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Burial Period
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Time likely to be taken to achieve burial.

S100FC:uom.S100Base:name: hour
S100FC:uom.S100Base:definition: unit of time being 60 minutes of 3600 seconds

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Owner Authority
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Denotes the 'owner' that is responsible for establishing and setting the protective marking level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Flare Stack
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A tall structure used for burning-off waste oil or gas.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Exit Usability
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Usability of exits from beach for vehicles and infantry.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Without Restriction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vehicles and infantry can cross any part of the back of the beach without restriction or hindrance.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Minimal Restriction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A number of vehicles can drive easily from the beach at the same time through a number of exits. Infantry can leave the beach and move inland without difficulty, along much of the beach.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Moderate Restriction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Exits are becoming fewer and smaller, usually accepting only one vehicle at a time. Infantry may be restricted to some extent by dense undergrowth, swamp, cliff, etc along part of the back of the beach. (AML)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Severe Restriction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Exits for vehicles and infantry are severely restricted in number and quality.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Land Region
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: General terms for describing landscapes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fen
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A type of bog, especially a low-lying area, wholly or partly covered with water and dominated by grass-like plants, grasses, sedges and reeds.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marsh
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of wet, often spongy ground that is subject to frequent flooding or tidal inundations, but not considered to be continually under water. It is characterized by the growth of non woody plants and by the lack of trees.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bog
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wet spongy ground consisting of decaying vegetation, which retains stagnant water, too soft to bear the weight of any heavy body.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Heathland
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tract of wasteland peat bog, usually covered by a low scrubby growth, but may have scattered small open water holes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mountain Range
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A series of connected and aligned mountains or mountain ridges.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lowlands
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Low and relatively level land at a lower elevation than adjoining areas.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canyon Lands
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively narrow, deep depression with steep sides, the bottom of which generally has a continuous slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Paddy Field
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A piece of land set aside for crops which are periodically flooded (for example rice paddy).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Agricultural Land
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Of or pertaining to the science or practice of cultivating the soil and rearing animals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Savanna/Grassland
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An open grassy plain with few or no trees in a tropical or subtropical region; a tract covered mainly by grasses that have little or no woody tissue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Parkland
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A piece of ground kept for ornament and/or recreation or maintained in its natural state as a public property or area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swamp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of spongy land saturated with water. It may have a shallow covering of water, usually with a considerable amount of vegetation appearing above the surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Landslide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sliding down of a mass of land on a mountain or cliff-side; land which has so fallen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lava Flow
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The substance that results from the cooling of molten rock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Salt Pan
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Shallow pools of brackish water used for the natural evaporation of sea water to obtain salt.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Moraine
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any accumulation of loose material deposited by a glacier.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Crater
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Bowl-shaped cavity, at the summit or on the side of a volcano.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cave
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural subterranean chamber or series of chambers open to the earth's surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rock Column or Pinnacle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any high tower or spire-shaped pillar of rock, alone or cresting a summit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A small insular feature usually with scant vegetation; usually of sand or coral. Often applied to smaller coral shoals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wadi
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A watercourse that is permanently dry or dry except for the rainy season.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Backshore
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: That part of a beach which is usually dry, being reached only by the highest tides. Also called backbeach. See also ForeshoreE.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Beach
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: On a shore, the area on which the waves break and over which shore debris, such as sand, shingle, pebbles accumulate. A beach includes backshore and foreshore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Foreshore
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: That part of shore which lies between high and low water mark at ordinary tide.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Nationality
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Identifier of membership of a particular nation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Mooring Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area in which vessels may be secured to mooring buoys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Small Craft Mooring Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which yachts and small boats moor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Area for Visitors
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which yachts and small boats moor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Area for Tankers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area set aside for the mooring of tankers.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Dumping Ground
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area based on the type of waste being disposed of.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chemical Waste Dumping Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area at sea where chemical waste is dumped.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nuclear Waste Dumping Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area at sea where nuclear waste is dumped.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Explosives Dumping Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area at sea where explosives are dumped.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spoil Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A sea area where dredged material is deposited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vessel Dumping Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area at sea where disused vessels are scuttled.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Exposition of Sounding
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the relationship of the depth of a feature to the range of depth of the surrounding depth area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Within the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth corresponds to the depth range of the surrounding depth area; that is, the depth is not shoaler than the minimum depth of the surrounding depth area or deeper than the maximum depth of the surrounding depth area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shoaler Than the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth is shoaler than the minimum depth of the surrounding depth area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Deeper Than the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth is deeper than the maximum depth of the surrounding depth area.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Fortified Structure
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the different types of fortified structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Castle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large fortified building or structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fort
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fortified enclosure, building, or position able to be defended against an enemy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Battery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fortified structure on which artillery is mounted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Blockhouse
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A concrete structure strengthened to give protection against enemy fire, with apertures to allow defensive gunfire.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fortified Tower
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A small circular fort with very thick walls (for example Martello tower).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Redoubt
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An outwork or fieldwork usually square or polygonal and without flanking defences.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fortified Submarine Shelter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fortified pen to hold submarines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rampart
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Anything serving as a bulwark or defence.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Visitors Mooring
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A mooring set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Last Detection Year
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The year in which the object was subsequently confirmed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Water Clarity
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indication of the particulate matter suspended in the water column by recording the visibilty through the water.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Lake Ice Stage of Development
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Lake Ice Stage of Development describes the ages and thicknesses of lake ice ('So,Sa,Sb,Sc and Sd').

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: New Lake Ice (5 cm)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Recently formed lake ice which includes frazil ice, slush and shuga and which is of less than 5 centimetres thickness. These types of ice are composed of ice crystals which are only weakly frozen together (if at all) and have a definite form only while they are afloat.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Thin Lake Ice (5 to 15 cm)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lake ice that is 5-15 cm in thickness.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Medium Lake Ice (15 to 30 cm)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ice, from 15 to 29 centimetres thick, formed on a river or on a lake and which may be exported to sea.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Thick Lake Ice (30 to 70 cm)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lake ice that is 30-70 cm in thickness.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Very Thick Lake Ice (70 cm)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lake ice that is greater than 70 cm in thickness.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Brash Ice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Accumulation of floating ice made up of fragments not more than 2 meters (6.6 feet) across; the wreckage of other forms of ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Edition Date
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Date of publishing for example of a publication, chart, or product.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Length
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The total vertical length of a feature.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Uncertainty Variable Factor
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The factor to be applied to the variable component of an uncertainty equation so as to provide the best estimate of the variable horizontal or vertical accuracy component for positions, depths, heights, vertical distances and vertical clearances.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Date Sunk
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Date on which the object sank or was abandoned to the sea.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Opening Bridge
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A bridge that is closed when set for carrying road traffic and open when set to permit marine traffic to pass through the waterway it crosses. Modern opening (movable) bridges are either bascule, vertical lift or swing.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Call Sign
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The designated call-sign of a station (radio station, radar station, pilot, ...).

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Object Source
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the source of the first or last report of the object.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Naval Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel operated by a recognized National Naval Authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Survey Boat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A boat used for hydrographic surveys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Merchant Ship
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a vessel operated by a merchant marine organisation, engaged in the transport of goods for payment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fishing Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel that is used and equipped for the fishing of living aquatic resources.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Research Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a vessel engaged in the business of conducting research into the sea and its environs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yacht
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a yacht, being a privately owned sailing or power boat used for pleasure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Charts
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given on a chart published by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Notices to Mariners
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given in a Notice to Mariners published by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Radio Navigational Warning
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given in a Radio Navigational Warning issued by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Files
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information held in a files maintained by a recognized Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Wreck Information
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information held in wreck records maintained by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lloyds and Marine Underwriters Reports
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from reports published by Lloyds or another marine underwriter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Owner
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: One who has the legal or rightful title to something.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coast Guard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Organization keeping watch on shipping and coastal waters according to governmental law; normally the authority with responsibility for search and rescue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hydrographic Note Report or Ship Visit
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information provided by a third party as a result of receipt of a ship visit or hydrographic note report by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aerial Photography
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The art, science, or process of taking aerial photographs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Geodetic Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey in which the figure and size of the earth is considered. It is applicable for large areas and long lines and is used for the precise location of basic points suitable for controlling other surveys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published World War 1 losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during world war one.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published World War 2 losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during world war two.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published other losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: the object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during periods outside of world wars one and two.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Satellite Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using instruments placed aboard an artificial satellite.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Orientation Uncertainty
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The best estimate of the accuracy of a bearing.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Special Purpose Mark
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an aid to navigation which signifies some special purpose.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Firing Danger Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a firing danger area, usually at sea.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Target Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any object toward which something is directed. The distinctive marking or instrumentation of a ground point to aid its identification on a photograph.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marker Ship Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark marking the position of a ship which is used as a target during some military exercise.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Degaussing Range Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a degaussing range.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Barge Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark of relevance to barges.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cable Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spoil Ground Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the limit of a spoil ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Outfall Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: ODAS
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ocean Data Acquisition System.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recording Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to record data for scientific purposes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seaplane Anchorage Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a seaplane anchorage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recreation Zone Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a recreation zone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a mooring or moorings.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: LANBY
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large buoy designed to take the place of a lightship where construction of an offshore light station is not feasible.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Leading Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Aids to navigation or other indicators so located as to indicate the path to be followed. Leading marks identify a leading line when they are in transit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Measured Distance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Notice Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A notice board or sign indicating information to the mariner.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: TSS Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a Traffic Separation Scheme.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Anchoring Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an anchoring prohibited area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Berthing Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that berthing is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Overtaking Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that overtaking is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Two-Way Traffic Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a one-way route.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reduced Wake Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Speed Limit Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a speed limit applies.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stop Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: General Warning Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sound Ship's Siren Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restricted Vertical Clearance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maximum Vessel's Draught Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the maximum draught of vessel permitted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restricted Horizontal Clearance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strong Current Warning Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark warning of strong currents.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Berthing Permitted Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that berthing is allowed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Overhead Power Cable Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an overhead power cable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Channel Edge Gradient Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telephone Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the presence of a telephone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ferry Crossing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route; often used with a 'sound ship's siren' mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pipeline Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Anchorage Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an anchorage area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Clearing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a clearing line.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Control Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diving Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that diving may take place in the vicinity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuge Beacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark providing or indicating a place of safety.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Foul Ground Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a foul ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yachting Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark installed for use by yachtsmen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Heliport Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an area where helicopters may land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: GNSS Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a location at which a GNSS position has been accurately determined.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seaplane Landing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an area where seaplanes land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Entry Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that entry is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Work in Progress Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mark With Unknown Purpose
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark whose detailed characteristics are unknown.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wellhead Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Channel Separation Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marine Farm Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm/culture.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Artificial Reef Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark, used year round, that may be submerged when ice passes through the area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nature Reserve Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to define the boundary of a nature reserve.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fish Aggregating Device
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fish aggregating (or aggregation) device (FAD) is a man-made object used to attract ocean going pelagic fish such as marlin, tuna and mahi-mahi (dolphin fish). They usually consist of buoys or floats tethered to the ocean floor with concrete blocks or adrift.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wreck Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a wreck.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Customs Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a customs checkpoint.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Causeway Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a causeway.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wave Recorder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A surface following buoy used to measure wave activity.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Agency Responsible for Production
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Identifies the agency which produced the data.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vessel Class
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The classification of a vessel, normally as defined by length or gross tonnage.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Keel Frequency
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the frequency of ice keels in number per nautical mile.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Lifting Capacity
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The specific safe lifting capacity of a feature.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: First Source
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the source of the original report of the object.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Naval Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel operated by a recognized National Naval Authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Survey Boat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A boat used for hydrographic surveys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Merchant Ship
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a vessel operated by a merchant marine organisation, engaged in the transport of goods for payment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fishing Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel that is used and equipped for the fishing of living aquatic resources.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Research Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a vessel engaged in the business of conducting research into the sea and its environs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yacht
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported by a yacht, being a privately owned sailing or power boat used for pleasure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Charts
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given on a chart published by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Notices to Mariners
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given in a Notice to Mariners published by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Radio Navigational Warning
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information given in a Radio Navigational Warning issued by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Files
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information held in a files maintained by a recognized Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: National Hydrographic Authority Wreck Information
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information held in wreck records maintained by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lloyds and Marine Underwriters Reports
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from reports published by Lloyds or another marine underwriter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Owner
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: One who has the legal or rightful title to something.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coast Guard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Organization keeping watch on shipping and coastal waters according to governmental law; normally the authority with responsibility for search and rescue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hydrographic Note Report or Ship Visit
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information provided by a third party as a result of receipt of a ship visit or hydrographic note report by a recognised Hydrographic Office or national authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aerial Photography
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The art, science, or process of taking aerial photographs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Geodetic Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey in which the figure and size of the earth is considered. It is applicable for large areas and long lines and is used for the precise location of basic points suitable for controlling other surveys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published World War 1 losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during world war one.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published World War 2 losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during world war two.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Published other losses
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: the object was sourced from information published in books or lists of vessels sunk during periods outside of world wars one and two.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Satellite Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using instruments placed aboard an artificial satellite.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category Of Patrol Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The classification of zone or grid relating to the patrol area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 4W Disposition Grid
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The 4W Disposition Grid is a NATO command system for the positioning of forces. It provides a framework for operating forces in widely dispersed groups.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Operational/Naval Patrol
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An offshore zone patrolled by naval vessels.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Gradient
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: (1) The change of any quantity with distance in any given direction. See Pressure Gradient, Temperature Lapse Rate. (2) The amount of slope, inclination to the horizontal, in road, railway, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Steep Gradient
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gradient measured in rise/run under 1:15.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Moderate Gradient
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gradient measured in rise/run between 1:15 and 1:30.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gentle Gradient
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gradient measured in rise/run between 1:30 and 1:60.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mild Gradient
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gradient measured in rise/run between 1:60 and 1:120.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flat Gradient
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gradient measured in rise/run over 1:120.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Stream Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The depth below the sea surface to which the tidal stream data refers relative to the sounding datum.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Relative Vertical Accuracy
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The vertical error estimate for the distance between two points, or the accuracy of one point with respect to another.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Height
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The value of the vertical distance to the highest point of the feature, measured from a specified vertical datum.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: First Sensor
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates by the use of which sensor the object was originally reported.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Acoustic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a sound signal being returned from the SBO.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Magnetic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: the object was reported as a result of detecting a fluctuation in the local magnetic field.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Video Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a sighting through electronic visual equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by a person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Physical Snag
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of the object fouling lines, anchors or fishing nets.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Observed Sinking
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a first hand observation of the object sinking.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reported Sinking
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The object was reported as a result of a report made by a third party or from published information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: None Reported
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The method by which the object was found was not reported.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Speed Units
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The units for description of speed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Kilometres Per Hour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A unit of speed, expressing the number of kilometres travelled in one hour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Miles Per Hour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An imperial and United States customary unit of speed expressing the number of statute miles covered in one hour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Knots
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A nautical unit of speed. One knot is one nautical mile per hour. The name is derived from the knots in the log line.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Sea Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area based on its physical characteristics.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural or artificial passage or channel through shoals or steep banks, or across a line of banks lying between two channels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bank
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elevation of the seafloor, at depths generally less than 200 m, but sufficient for safe surface navigation, commonly found on the continental shelf or near an island.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Deep
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: In oceanography, an obsolete term which was generally restricted to depths greater than 6,000 m.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wide indentation in the coastline generally smaller than a gulf and larger than a cove. For the purposes of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, a bay is a well-marked indentation whose penetration is in such proportion to the width of its mouth as to contain land locked waters and constitute more than a mere curvature of the coast.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trench
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long, deep, asymmetrical depression with relatively steep sides, that is associated with subduction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Basin
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depression of the seafloor more or less equidimensional in plan and of variable extent.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mud Flats
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A level tract of land, as the bed of a dry lake or an area frequently uncovered at low tide. Usually in plural.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reef
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shallow elevation composed of consolidated material that may constitute a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ledge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rocky formation continuous with and fringing the shore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canyon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, narrow, steep-sided depression that generally deepens down-slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Narrows
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A navigable narrow part of a bay, strait, river, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shoal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shallow elevation composed of unconsolidated material that may constitute a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Knoll
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A distinct elevation with a rounded profile less than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated elevation of varying complexity and size, generally having steep sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seamount
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A distinct generally equidimensional elevation greater than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pinnacle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any high tower or spire-shaped pillar or rock or coral, alone or cresting a summit. It may extend above the surface of the water. It may or may not be a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Abyssal Plain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An extensive, flat, gently sloping or nearly level region at abyssal depths.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Plateau
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large, relatively flat elevation that is higher than the surrounding relief with one or more relatively steep sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spur
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A subordinate ridge protruding from a larger feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shelf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The flat or gently sloping region adjacent to a continent or around an island that extends from the low water line to a depth, generally about 200m, where there is a marked increase in downward slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trough
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long depression generally wide and flat bottomed with symmetrical and parallel sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Saddle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A broad pass or col in a ridge, rise or other elevation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Abyssal Hill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An isolated small elevation on the deep seafloor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Apron
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gently dipping slope, with a smooth surface, commonly found around groups of islands and seamounts.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Archipelagic Apron
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gentle slope with a generally smooth surface of the seafloor, characteristically found around groups of islands or seamounts.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Borderland
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A region adjacent to a continent, normally occupied by or bordering a shelf and sometimes emerging as islands, that is irregular or blocky in plan or profile, with depths well in excess of those typical of a shelf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Continental Margin
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The zone, generally consisting of shelf, slope and continental rise, separating the continent from the deep seafloor or abyssal plain or plain. Occasionally a trench may be present in place of a continental rise.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Continental Rise
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gentle slope rising from the oceanic depths towards the foot of a continental slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Escarpment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, characteristically linear, steep slope separating horizontal or gently sloping areas of the seafloor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fan
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively smooth, depositional feature continuously deepening away from a sediment source commonly located at the lower termination of a canyon or canyon system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fracture Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow zone of irregular topography formed by the movement of tectonic plates associated with an offset of a spreading ridge axis, characterized by steep-sided and/or asymmetrical ridges, troughs or escarpments.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A narrow break in a ridge, rise or other elevation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Guyot
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A seamount having a comparatively smooth flat top.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: [1] A small isolated elevation, smaller than a mountain. [2] A distinct elevation generally of irregular shape, less than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depression of limited extent with all sides rising steeply from a relatively flat bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Levee
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depositional embankment bordering a canyon, valley or sea channel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Median Valley
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The axial depression of the mid-oceanic ridge system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Moat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An annular or partially annular depression commonly located at the base of seamounts, islands and other isolated elevations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mountains
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural elevation of the earth's surface rising more or less abruptly from the surrounding level, and attaining an altitude which, relatively to adjacent elevations, is impressive or notable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Peak
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A conical or pointed elevation on a larger feature such as a seamount.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Province
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A geographically distinct region with a number of shared physiographic characteristics that contrast with those in the surrounding areas. This term should be modified with the generic term that best describes the majority of features in the region, for example "Seamount" in Baja California Seamount Province.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rise
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A broad elevation that generally rises gently and smoothly from the surrounding relief.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sea Channel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, meandering depression, usually occurring on a gently sloping plain or fan.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seamount Chain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Several seamounts in linear or arcuate alignment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shelf-Edge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The line along which there is a marked increase in slope at the seaward margin of a shelf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively shallow barrier between BASINS that may inhibit water movement.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slope
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sloping region that deepens from a shelf to the point where there is a general decrease in gradient.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Terrace
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A flat or gently sloping region, generally long and narrow, bounded along one edge by a steeper descending slope and along the other by a steeper ascending slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Valley
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated depression that generally widens and deepens down-slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An artificial waterway with no flow, or a controlled flow, used for navigation, or for draining or irrigating land (ditch).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lake
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large body of water entirely surrounded by land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: River
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively large natural stream of water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reach
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A straight section of a river, especially a navigable river between two bends; or an arm of the sea extending into the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Intertidal Cay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low, flat island of sand, coral, etc. awash or submerged at high water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Submarine Volcano
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A seabed volcano, submerged at the chart sounding datum, which may or may not be active.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Ridge Mean Height
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the mean height of ice ridge(s) in decimetres.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Clearance Unlimited
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A statement that expresses if the vertical clearance for a feature in the open position, such as a bridge span, is unlimited.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Periodic Date End
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The end of the active period for a seasonal object (for example a buoy).

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Quality Of Beach Survey
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indication of the quality of the beach survey.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Size of Features Detected
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The size of detected bathymetric features in an area.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Concentration of Strips and Patches
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A strip is a long narrow area of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, usually composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current. If the area becomes more rounded in shape, it is referred to as a patch. Indicates the concentration in tenths within with area of Strips and Patches.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 1/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 10% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 2/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 20% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 3/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 30% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 4/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 40% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 5/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 50% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 6/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 60% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 7/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 70% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations (8/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 80% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 9/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 90% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strips and Patches (Concentrations 10/10)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow area composed of about 100% of floating ice, about 1 kilometre or less in width, composed of small fragments detached from the main mass of ice, and run together under the influence of wind, swell or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Temporal Variation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: An assessment of the likelihood of change over time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Extreme Event
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Indication of the possible impact of a significant event (for example hurricane, earthquake, volcanic eruption, landslide, etc), which is considered likely to have changed the seafloor or landscape significantly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change and Significant Shoaling Expected
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example river siltation, sand waves, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is likely to result in new significant shoaling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change But Significant Shoaling Not Expected
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example sand wave shift, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is not likely to result in new significant shoaling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change to non-bathymetric features (for example river siltation, glacier creep/recession, sand dunes, buoys, marine farms, etc).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unlikely to Change
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Significant change to the seafloor is not expected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unassessed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Not having been assessed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Station Number
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The identification number of the reference tide station with reference water level for tidal stream panel observations.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Drawing Index
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A numeric value used to indicate that datasets are intended to form a seamless presentation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Signal Frequency
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The frequency of a signal.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Nature Of Geological Layer
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Type of rock or sediment making up the geological layer.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undifferentiated metamorphic rock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Rock formed by alteration of existing rocks by heat, pressure, or other processes in the earth's crust.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undifferentiated igneous and volcanic rock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Rock formed by solidification of molten material or magma.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Granite
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Light-coloured, acidic igneous rock mineralogically composed primarily of quartz and potassium-sodium rich feldspars in which the mineral grains are visible to the naked eye (phaneritic texture).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dolerite
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A basic igneous rock occurring in minor intrusions such as sills and dykes. Usually dark coloured and fine or medium textured.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Basalt
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Dark grey to black, dense to fine-grained, extrusive igneous rock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gneiss
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A coarse-grained crystalline rock of foliated texture and of streaked, wavy or banded appearance. Formed by the metamorphism of granite and other igneous rocks.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Schist
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A foliated metamorphic rock which can be split into thin flakes or flat lenticles. Schists are usually named from the dominant mineral, e.g. mica schist.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marble
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Limestone that has been crystallised in varying degrees by metamorphism. It ranges from granular to compact in texture and can be black or white, tinted, veined, or mottled with various colours.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Quartzite
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A compact granular rock composed of quartz. It is a metamorphosed sandstone in which the siliceous element is often so blended with the quartz grains so as to give the rock a nearly homogenous texture.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slate
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A dense fine-grained rock produced by the compression of clays, shales and various other rocks that develops a characteristic cleavage which may be at any angle with the original bedding plane.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breccia
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rock consisting of sharp fragments embedded in a fine-grained matrix.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Conglomerate
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sedimentary rock composed of rounded fragments varying from small pebbles to larger boulders in a cement of calcareous material, iron oxide, silica or hardened clay.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coral
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Hard calcareous skeletons of many tribes of marine polyps.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Clays
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Mineralogically, a hydrous aluminium silicate material with plastic properties and a crystal structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shale
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Clay rock that splits readily into thin layers along the bedding planes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Siltstone and Mudstone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Types of rock formed of compacted and hardened silt and mud.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sandstone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A type of rock formed of compacted and hardened sand.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Limestone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rock which consists chiefly of calcium carbonate.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chalk
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rock that consists chiefly of calcium carbonate.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Evaporite
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A white soft rock, composed of calcium carbonate.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mud
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Soft, wet earth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Silt
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An unconsolidated sediment whose particles range in size from 0.0039 to 0.0625 millimetres in diameter (between clay and sand size).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sand
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Loose material consisting of small but easily distinguishable, separate grains, between 0.0625 and 2.000 millimetres in diameter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A general term for rock and rock fragments ranging in size from pebbles and gravel to boulders or large rock masses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gravel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (Particles of 2.0 - 4.0mm); small stones with coarse sand.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pebbles
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A small stone worn smooth and rounded by the action of water, sand, ice, etc. ranging in diameter between 4 and 64 millimetres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cobbles
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A naturally rounded stone larger than a pebble.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any formation of natural origin that constitutes an integral part of the lithosphere. The natural occurring material that forms firm, hard, and solid masses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lava
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The fluid or semi-fluid matter flowing from a volcano. The substance that results from the cooling of the molten rock. Part of the ocean bed is composed of lava.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shells
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The hard outside covering of an animal. Part of the ocean bed is composed of numerous shells of marine animals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boulder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rounded rock with diameter of 256 millimetres or larger.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sandy mud (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural salt or mineral deposit formed by evaporation of water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slightly gravelly mud (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Mud-dominated sediment containing 1–5% gravel and minor sand; typically over 75% mud by weight.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slightly gravelly sandy mud (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Mud-dominated sediment with subordinate sand and 1–5% gravel; sand content generally ranges from 20–40%.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gravelly mud (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Mud-rich sediment containing 5–30% gravel and minor sand; mud remains the dominant component.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Muddy Sand (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sand-dominated sediment containing 25–50% mud and less than 5% gravel; exhibits moderate cohesion.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slightly gravelly sand (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sand-dominated sediment with 1–5% gravel and minimal mud; retains high permeability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slightly gravelly muddy sand (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sand-dominated sediment containing 15–30% mud and 1–5% gravel; transitional between clean sand and more cohesive mixtures.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gravelly muddy sand (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sand-dominated sediment with 5–30% gravel and 15–30% mud; typically found in high-energy depositional environments.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gravelly sand (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sand-dominated sediment containing 5–30% gravel and little to no mud; grain-supported and well-drained.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Muddy Gravel (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Gravel-dominated sediment with over 25% mud; matrix-supported texture with limited permeability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Muddy sandy gravel (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Gravel-dominated sediment with significant mud and sand components; often indicates mixed transport regimes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sandy Gravel (Folk)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Gravel-dominated sediment containing 25–50% sand and minimal mud; characteristic of high-energy, nearshore zones.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Crystalline Rock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inexact but convenient term designating an igneus or metamorphic rock as opposed to a sedimentary rock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sedimentary Rock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rock resulting from the consolidation of loose sediment that has accumulated in layers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Till
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unstratified glacial drift consisting of clay, sand, gravel, and boulders intermingled in any proportions. Also called boulder clay.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Glaciofluvial Drift
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A general term for for drift transported and deposited by running water emanating from a glacier.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Status
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The condition of an object at a given instant in time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Permanent
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Intended to last or function indefinitely.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Occasional
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Acting on special occasions; happening irregularly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recommended
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Presented as worthy of confidence, acceptance, use, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Not in Use
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Use has ceased, but the facility still exists intact; disused.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Periodic/Intermittent
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Recurring at intervals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reserved
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Set apart for some specific use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Temporary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Meant to last only for a time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Private
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Administered by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mandatory
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Compulsory; enforced.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Extinguished
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: No longer lit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Illuminated
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lit by flood lights, strip lights, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Historic
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Famous in history; of historical interest.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Public
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Belonging to, available to, used or shared by, the community as a whole and not restricted to private use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Synchronized
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Occur at a time, coincide in point of time, be contemporary or simultaneous.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Watched
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Looked at or observed over a period of time especially so as to be aware of any movement or change.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unwatched
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Usually automatic in operation, without any permanently-stationed personnel to superintend it.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Existence Doubtful
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A feature that has been reported but has not been definitely determined to exist.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Buoyed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Marked by buoys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Active In Use
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being used for the purpose intended; used.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Claimed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A coastal State claims or may claim a specific jurisdiction in accordance with the provisions of International Law.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Practice And/Or Exercise Purposes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Used for military practice and/or exercise purposes only.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recognised
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Acknowledged and agreed in accordance with the provisions of International Law

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dead
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: not detected by repeated surveys, leading to doubts about the object's existence. (AML)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lifted
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An object that has been salvaged or removed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mass Grave
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Where a significant number of persons have perished as a direct result of a vessel or structure sinking and their remains cannot be recovered, the wreck and immediate area may be declared as a Mass Grave or more specifically, a War Grave. Such sites are protected from disturbance by International Law.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Exploration
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: a borehole drilled in the search for a new source of oil or gas. (An A-Z of Offshore Oil & Gas by Harry Whitehead, 2nd Ed, 1983, Gulf Publishing Company)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Production
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A product or service that is currently in production.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Suspended
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: a well where the extraction of oil or gas has been temporarily abandoned. When suspended, a well is either plugged (filled with concrete and topped with a steel plate) or capped (well-head equipment is installed over the well). (Adapted from An A-Z of Offshore Oil & Gas by Harry Whitehead, 2nd Ed, 1983, Gulf Publishing Company)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Injection
