S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Very Small Fracture (1 m to 50 m Wide)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any break or rupture between 1 and 50 metres wide through very close ice, compact ice, consolidated ice, fast ice, or a single floe resulting from deformation processes. Fractures may contain brash ice and/or be covered with nilas and/or young ice. Length may vary from a few meters to many kilometres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Small Fracture (50 m to 200 m Wide)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any break or rupture between 50 and 200 metres wide through very close ice, compact ice, consolidated ice, fast ice, or a single floe resulting from deformation processes. Fractures may contain brash ice and/or be covered with nilas and/or young ice. Length may vary from a few metres to many kilometres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Medium Fracture (200 m to 500 m Wide)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A restricted space of width 200 to 500 m, the length of which is comparable with the width of ice-free water, or very open broken ice among solid, very close and close ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Large Fracture (500 m Wide)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A restricted space, the length of which is comparable with the width of ice-free water, or very open broken ice among solid, very close and close ice; and the width of which is greater than 500 metres.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Airspace Restriction
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Category of airspace restriction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Danger Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area designated by a proper authority, in which a danger to craft exists. Also called danger zone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Prohibited Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (1) An area shown on charts within which navigation and/or anchoring is prohibited. (2) In aviation terminology, a specified area within the land areas of a state or territorial waters adjacent thereto over which the flight of aircraft is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restricted Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority within which navigation is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Checkpoint
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a place where vehicles or travellers are stopped for identification or inspection.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Custom
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Serves as a government checkpoint where customs duties are collected, the flow of goods are regulated and restrictions enforced, and shipments or vehicles are cleared for entering or leaving a country.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rendezvous Location
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Specified location that is identified and used as a rendezvous point.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Least Depth of Detected Features Measured
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Expression stating if the least depth of detected features in an area was measured.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Colour Pattern
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A regular repeated design containing more than one colour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Horizontal Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented horizontally.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vertical Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented vertically.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diagonal Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented diagonally (that is, not horizontally or vertically).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Squared
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Often referred to as checker plate, where alternate colours are used to create squares similar to a chess or draught board. The pattern may be straight or diagonal.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stripes (Direction Unknown)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented in an unknown direction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Border Stripe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A band or stripe of colour which is displayed around the outer edge of the feature, which may also form a border to an inner pattern or plain colour.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Reference Tide Type
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The type of tide range (that is, mean spring tide, mean neap tide or mean tide) for which a set of tidal stream rates and directions apply.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The tides of increased range occurring near the times of full moon and new moon.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Neaps
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The tides of decreased range occurring near the times of first and last quarter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The tides of mean range occurring between spring and neap tides.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Drift Speed
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The speed of displacement of ice floes and other ice features resulting from the impact of wind and currents including tidal currents and of forces transferred through the ice cover from other regions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Growler (1 m ASL)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A smaller piece of ice of land origin than a bergy bit and extending no more than 1 metre above sea level. The color is usually white, but sometimes transparent or blue-green or nearly black, normally occupying an area of about 20 square metres. Growlers are distinguished with difficulty when they are surrounded by ice and also in heavy swell.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bergy Bit (1-5 m ASL; 5-15 m Length)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Bergy Bit (1-5 m asl; 5-15 m length).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Small Iceberg (5-15 m ASL; 15-60 m Length)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A massive piece of ice of varying shape, protruding from 5 to 15 metres above sea level and 15 to 60 metres in length, which has broken away from a glacier or an ice shelf, and which may be afloat or aground. Icebergs by their external look may be subdivided into tabular, dome-shaped, sloping and rounded bergs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Medium Iceberg (16 to 45 m ASL; 61 to 120 m Length)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A massive piece of ice of varying shape, protruding from 16 to 45 metres above sea level and 61 to 120 metres in length, which has broken away from a glacier or an ice shelf, and which may be afloat or aground. Icebergs by their external look may be subdivided into tabular, dome-shaped, sloping and rounded bergs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Large Iceberg (46 to 75 m ASL; 121 to 200 m Length)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A massive piece of ice of varying shape, protruding from 46 to 75 metres above sea level and 121 to 200 metres in length, which has broken away from a glacier or an ice shelf, and which may be afloat or aground. Icebergs by their external look may be subdivided into tabular, dome-shaped, sloping and rounded bergs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Very Large Iceberg (75 m ASL; 200 m Length)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A massive piece of ice of varying shape, protruding from over 75 metres above sea level and over 200 metres in length, which has broken away from a glacier or an ice shelf, and which may be afloat or aground. Icebergs by their external look may be subdivided into tabular, dome-shaped, sloping and rounded bergs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Island Fragment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large piece of floating ice protruding about 5 m above sea-level, which has broken away from an Arctic ice shelf, having a thickness of 15-30 metres and an area of from a few thousand square meters to 500 square km or more, and usually characterized by a regularly undulating surface which gives it a ribbed appearance from the air.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Island (in the Northern Hemisphere) or Very Large Tabular Berg (in the Southern Ocean)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large piece of floating ice protruding about 5 metres above sea-level, which has broken away from an Arctic ice shelf, having a thickness of 15-30 metres and an area of from a few thousand square metres to 500 square km or more, and usually characterized by a regularly undulating surface which gives it a ribbed appearance from the air.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radar Target
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An object which reflects a sufficient amount of a radar signal to produce an echo signal on the radar screen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Radar Conspicuous
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A feature which returns a strong radar echo.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Heading Down Bearing
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The horizontal direction heading down a Q-Route (e.g. D to C to B to A), expressed as the angular distance from true north. It is usually measured from 0 at the reference direction clockwise through 360.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: General Water Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The general depth of the water in the vicinity of the object.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Snow Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Specifies the depth of snow cover on the ice in centimetres.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Measurement Distance Maximum
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximum spacing of the principal measurement lines of a hydrographic survey.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Controlled Airspace
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Air Traffic Services airspace classifications, applicable to the ATS airspace, as defined by the governing aviation authority and in accordance with ICAO standards

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Airway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A control area or portion thereof established in the form of a corridor equipped with radio navigation aids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Altimeter Setting Region (ASR)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A geographical region for which the lowest value of QNH is forecast hourly by a Forecasting Office and relayed by Air Traffic Control Centres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Avoidance Area (AA)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Areas that pilots must avoid during specified periods in which activity, or activities, considered a hazard to flight may exist. They have been established to prohibit low flying over areas of high population density and in certain types of regulated airspace.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Control Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified height above the earth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Control Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from the surface of the earth to a specified upper limit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flight Information Region
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information and alerting services are provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Terminal Control Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A control area normally situated at the confluence of ATS Routes in the vicinity of one or more major aerodromes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aerodrome Traffic Zone (ATZ)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Except for any part of the airspace within the ATZ of another aerodrome which is notified as being the controlling aerodrome.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Helicopter Protection Zone (HPZ)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified height above the earth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Helicopter Main Route (HMR)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A route where helicopters operate on a regular and frequent basis, and where Alerting Service, Flight Information Service, or Advisory Service may be provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Helicopter Transit Corridor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A corridor of defined dimensions where helicopters operate on a regular and frequent basis, and where Alerting Service, Flight Information Service, or Advisory Service may be provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Aerodrome Traffic Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A zone established at military aerodromes within which increased protection may be given to aircraft in the critical stages of circuit, approach and climb-out.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ocean Control Area (OCA)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified height above an oceanic region of the earth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coastguard track [surveillance]
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A route between two or more Coastguard reporting points.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Terminal Control Area (MTCA)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Military equivalent of a Terminal Control Area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Identification Zone (ADIZ)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Air Defence Airspace of defined dimensions within which the ready identification, location and control of aircraft is required.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Advisory Area (ADA) or (UDA)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A specific region of airspace that is established to provide pilots with important information and services.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Air Route Traffic Control Center (ARTCC)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A facility established to provide air traffic control service to aircraft operating on instrument flight rules (IFR) flight plans within controlled airspace and principally during the en route phase of flight. When equipment capabilities and controller workload permit, certain advisory/assistance services may be provided to aircraft flying under visual flight rules (VFR).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Area Control Center (ACC)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An air traffic control facility primarily responsible for ATC services being provided IFR aircraft during the en route phase of flight. The U.S. equivalent facility is an air route traffic control center (ARTCC)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radar Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An airspace for which a radar service is specified.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Upper Flight Information Region (UIR)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An upper airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided. Each state determines its definition for upper airspace.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Buffer Zone (BZ)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Flight Plan Buffer Zone (FBZ) is an airspace volume, which may be established in association to a reserved/restricted area. The FBZ defines the lateral, vertical and time limits for the purpose of validating submitted IFR flight plans when the associated area is activated or planned to be activated.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Flare Bearing
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The bearing about which the light flare symbol is rotated to be displayed in ECDIS.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Cable
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the cable based on the services provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Power Line
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cable that transmits or distributes electrical power.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Transmission Line
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Multiple un-insulated cables usually supported by steel lattice towers. Such features are generally more prominent than normal power lines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Cable
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A chain or very strong fibre or wire rope used to anchor or moor vessels or buoys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ferry
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel for transporting passengers, vehicles, and/or goods across a stretch of water, especially as a regular service.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Junction Cable
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cable used for joining components of complex marine structures, for example mooring trots.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telecommunications Cable
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cable used for the transmission and reception of modulated communication waves/signals.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Offshore Production Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area at sea within which there are production facilities.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wind Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of wind turbines that are collocated and are organized as a single power generation unit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wave Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of collocated devices which harness wave energy and are organized as a single power generation unit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Current Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of collocated devices which harness current (for example tidal) energy and are organized as a single power generation unit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tank Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of collocated large-capacity tanks in which petroleum, natural gas, or liquid petrochemicals are stored.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seabed Material Extraction Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which materials forming, or under, the seabed are removed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solar Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large-scale photovoltaic system (PV system) designed for the supply of merchant power into the electricity grid. They are differentiated from most building-mounted and other decentralised solar power applications because they supply power at the utility level, rather than to a local user or users. The generic expression utility-scale solar is sometimes used to describe this type of project.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Producer Nation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The authority who produced a nautical product.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Minimum Altitude
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Height (AGL - above ground level) above surface level to the lowest portion of the feature.

S100FC:uom.S100Base:name: foot
S100FC:uom.S100Base:definition: a unit of length equal to 12 inches, 1/6 of a fathom, or 30.480 centimetres

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Full Seafloor Coverage Achieved
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Expression stating if full seafloor coverage has been achieved in the area covered by hydrographic surveys.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Magnetic Intensity
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Magnetic intensity generated by the object.

S100FC:uom.S100Base:name: nanotesla
S100FC:uom.S100Base:definition: a measure of magnetic flux density being 1 billionth (10^-9) teslas

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Caveat
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A component of a security classification used for authorizing a specific group to have access rights.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Airport/Airfield
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of airport/airfield based on the primary aircraft and user group.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Aeroplane Airport
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large military airfield usually equipped with a control tower, hangars and accommodation for the receiving and discharging of passengers or cargo.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Civil Aeroplane Airport
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large airfield usually equipped with a control tower, hangars and accommodation for the receiving and discharging of passengers or cargo.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Heliport
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A landing place for helicopters controlled by the military.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Civil Heliport
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A landing place for helicopters, often the roof of a building.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Glider Airfield
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of land set aside for the take-off and landing of gliders.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Small Planes Airfield
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of land set aside for the take-off and landing of small aeroplanes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Emergency Airfield
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of land set aside for the take-off and landing of aeroplanes or helicopters in times of emergency.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Search and Rescue Airfield
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of land set aside for the take-off and landing of aeroplanes or helicopters in times of search and rescue.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Signal Station, Warning
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of station based on the warning service provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Danger
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a danger to navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maritime Obstruction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a maritime obstruction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cable
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a cable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Practice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of activity in a military practice area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Distress
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A station that may receive or transmit distress signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Weather
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A visual signal displayed to indicate a weather forecast.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Storm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information about storm conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Warning
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information about ice conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Time
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An accurate signal marking a specified time or time interval. It is used primarily for determining errors of timepieces. Such signals are usually sent from an observatory by radio, but visual signals are used at some ports.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information on tidal conditions in the area in question.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tidal Stream
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information on condition of tidal currents in the area in question.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide Gauge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A device for measuring the height of tide. A graduated staff in a sheltered area where visual observations can be made; or it may consist of an elaborate recording instrument making a continuous graphic record of tide height against time. Such an instrument is usually actuated by a float in a pipe communicating with the sea through a small hole which filters out shorter waves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide Scale
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A visual scale which directly shows the height of the water above chart datum or a local datum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diving
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of diving activity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Level Gauge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A device for measuring and conveying information about the water level (non-tidal) in the area in question.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Quality of Horizontal Measurement
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The degree of reliability attributed to a position.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A position that is considered to be less than third-order accuracy, but is generally considered to be within 30.5 metres of its correct geographic location. Also may apply to a feature whose position does not remain fixed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Position Doubtful
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Of uncertain position. The expression is used principally on charts to indicate that a wreck, shoal, etc., has been reported in various positions and not definitely determined in any.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Floe Sizes
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Floe Sizes describe the predominate forms of ice floe sizes (Fa,Fb and Fc), corresponding to the ice Stages of Development (Sa,Sb and Sc) respectively.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pancake Ice (30 cm to 3 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Predominantly circular plates of ice from 30 cm to 3 m in diameter, and up to about 10 cm in thickness, with raised rims due to the pieces striking against one another. It may be formed on a slight swell from grease ice, shuga or slush or as a result of the breaking of ice rind, nilas or, under heavy swell, of grey ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shuga/Small Ice Cake; Brash Ice (2 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An accumulation of spongy white ice lumps, a few centimetres across; they are formed from grease ice or slush and sometimes from anchor ice rising to the surface. Accumulations of floating ice made up of fragments not more than 2 m across, the wreckage of other forms of ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Cake (20 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any relatively flat piece of sea ice less than 20 m across.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Small Floe (20 to 100 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any contiguous piece of sea ice, from 20 to 100 metres across.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Medium Floe (100 to 500 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively flat piece of sea ice 100 m to 500 m across. Floes are subdivided according to horizontal extent.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Big Floe (500 to 2000 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Separate patch of floating ice or flat sheet of unbroken pack ice, greater than 20 metres (22 yards) across. A big floe is a floe of size 500 to 2000 metres across.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vast Floe (2000 to 10000 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any contiguous piece of sea ice, 2-10 kilometres across.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Giant Floe (10000 m Across)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively flat piece of sea ice 10 km or more across.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fast Ice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sea ice which remains fast, generally in the position where originally formed, and which may attain a considerable thickness. It is found along coasts, where it is attached to the shore, or over shoals, where it may be held in position by islands, grounded icebergs or grounded polar ice.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Growlers, Floebergs or Floebits
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Growler: A smaller piece of ice of land origin than a bergy bit. The color is usually white, but sometimes transparent or blue-green or nearly black, normally occupying an area of about 20 m2 . Growlers are distinguished with difficulty when they are surrounded by ice and also in heavy swell. Floeberg: A massive piece of sea ice composed of a hummock, or a group of hummocks frozen together, presenting a separate floating ice fragment in ice-free water or among separate ice fragments. It may protrude up to 5 m above sea-level.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Icebergs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Massive pieces of ice of varying shape, protruding more than 5 m above sea-level, which have broken away from a glacier or an ice shelf, and which may be afloat or aground. Icebergs by their external look may be subdivided into tabular, dome-shaped, sloping and rounded bergs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Light Visibility
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The specific visibility of a light, with respect to the light's intensity and ease of recognition.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: High Intensity
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Non-marine lights with a higher power than marine lights and visible from well off shore (often 'Aero' lights).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Low Intensity
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Non-marine lights with lower power than marine lights.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Faint
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A decrease in the apparent intensity of a light which may occur in the case of partial obstructions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Intensified
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light in a sector is intensified (that is, has longer range than other sectors).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unintensified
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light in a sector is unintensified (that is, has shorter range than other sectors).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Visibility Deliberately Restricted
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light sector is deliberately reduced in intensity, for example to reduce its effect on a built-up area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Obscured
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Said of the arc of a light sector designated by its limiting bearings in which the light is not visible from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Partially Obscured
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: This value specifies that parts of the sector are obscured.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Visible in Line of Range
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lights that must be in line to be visible.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Date End
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The latest date on which an object (for example a buoy) will be present.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Radio Station
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of radio services offered by a radio station.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Circular (Non-Directional) Marine or Aero-Marine Radiobeacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio station which need not necessarily be manned, the emissions of which, radiated around the horizon, enable its bearing to be determined by means of the radio direction finder of a ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Directional Radiobeacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A special type of radiobeacon station the emissions of which are intended to provide a definite track for guidance.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rotating Pattern Radiobeacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A special type of radiobeacon station emitting a beam of waves to which a uniform turning movement is given, the bearing of the station being determined by means of an ordinary listening receiver and a stop watch. Also referred to as a rotating loop radiobeacon.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Consol Beacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A type of long range position fixing beacon.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radio Direction-Finding Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio station intended to determine only the direction of other stations by means of transmission from the latter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coast Radio Station Providing QTG Service
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio station which is prepared to provide QTG service; that is to say, to transmit upon request from a ship a radio signal, the bearing of which can be taken by that ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aeronautical Radiobeacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio beacon designed for aeronautical use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Decca
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The Decca Navigator System is a high accuracy, short to medium range radio navigational aid intended for coastal and landfall navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Loran C
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low frequency electronic position fixing system using pulsed transmissions at 100 Khz.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Differential GPS
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Differential GPS is implemented by placing a GPS monitor receiver at a precisely known location. Instead of computing a navigation fix, the monitor determines the range error to every GPS satellite it can track. These ranging errors are then transmitted to local users where they are applied as corrections before computing the navigation result.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Toran
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An electronic position fixing system used mainly by aircraft.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Omega
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long-range radio navigational aid which operates within the VLF frequency band. The system comprises eight land based stations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Syledis
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A ranging position fixing system operating at 420-450 MHz over a range of up to 400 Km.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chaika
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low frequency electronic position fixing system using pulsed transmissions at 100 Khz.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radio Telephone Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The equipment needed at one station to carry on two way voice communication by radio waves only.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: AIS Base Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An AIS shore station for use by competent authorities to provide AIS service, manage the data link and enable effective ship to shore / shore to ship transmission of information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) is defined as a navigation beacon, usually coupled with a VOR beacon, to enable aircraft to measure their position relative to that beacon. Aircraft send out a signal which is sent back after a fixed delay by the DME ground equipment. An aircraft can compute its distance to the beacon from the delay of the signal perceived by the aircraft's DME equipment using the speed of light.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Non-directional Radio Beacon (NDB)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A non-directional beacon (NDB) is a radio beacon operating in the MF or LF band-widths. NDBs transmit a signal of equal strength in all directions. The signal contains a coded element which is used for station identification (normally 1-3 letters in Morse Code).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radar Responder Beacon (RACON)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar transponder beacon which emits a characteristic signal when triggered by emissions of ships' or aircraft radars.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: VHF Omni Directional Radio Range (VOR)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An aircraft navigation system operating in the VHF band. VORs broadcast a VHF radio composite signal including the station's Morse Code identifier (and sometimes a voice identifier), and data that allows the airborne receiving equipment to derive the magnetic bearing from the station to the aircraft.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: VHF Omni Directional (VORTAC)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A VORTAC is a facility consisting of two components, VOR and TACAN, which provides three individual services: VOR azimuth, TACAN azimuth and TACAN distance (DME) at one site. Although consisting of more than one component, incorporating more than one operating frequency, and using more than one antenna system, a VORTAC is considered to be a unified navigational aid. Both components of a VORTAC are envisioned as operating simultaneously and providing the three services at all times.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tactical Air Navigation Equipment (TACAN)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tactical air navigation system, commonly referred to by the acronym TACAN, is a navigation system used by military aircraft. It provides the user with bearing and distance (slant-range or hypotenuse) to a ground or ship-borne station.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Leisure Activity
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Type of leisure activity taking place.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Landmark
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of prominent cultural and natural features in the landscape.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cairn
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mound of stones, usually conical or pyramidal, raised as a landmark or to designate a point of importance in surveying.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cemetery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A site and associated structures devoted to the burial of the dead.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chimney
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical structure containing a passage or flue for discharging smoke and gases of combustion.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dish Aerial
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A parabolic aerial for the receipt and transmission of high frequency radio signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flagstaff
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A staff or pole on which flags are raised.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flare Stack
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tall structure used for burning-off waste oil or gas.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mast
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively tall structure usually held vertical by guy lines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Windsock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tapered fabric sleeve mounted so as to catch and swing with the wind, thus indicating the wind direction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Monument
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure erected and/or maintained as a memorial to a person and/or event.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Column/Pillar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cylindrical or slightly tapering body of considerably greater length than diameter erected vertically.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Memorial Plaque
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A slab of metal, usually ornamented, erected as a memorial to a person or event.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Obelisk
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tapering shaft usually of stone or concrete, square or rectangular in section, with a pyramidal apex.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Statue
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A representation of a living being, sculptured, moulded, or cast in a variety of materials (for example: marble, metal, or plaster).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cross
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A monument, or other structure in form of a cross.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dome
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A landmark comprising a hemispherical or spheroidal shaped structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radar Scanner
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A device used for directing a radar beam through a search pattern.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tower
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively tall, narrow structure that may either stand alone or may form part of another structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Windmill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A system of vanes attached to a tower and driven by wind (excluding wind turbines).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spire/Minaret
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tall conical or pyramid-shaped structure often built on the roof or tower of a building, especially a church or mosque.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Large Rock or Boulder on Land
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An isolated rocky formation or a single large stone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Triangulation Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A recoverable point on the earth, whose geographic position has been determined by angular methods with geodetic instruments. A triangulation point is a selected point, which has been marked with a station mark, or it is a conspicuous natural or artificial feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boundary Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A marker identifying the location of a surveyed boundary line.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Observation Wheel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wheels with passenger cars mounted external to the rim and independently rotated by electric motors.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Torii
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A form of decorative gateway or portal, consisting of two upright wooden posts connected at the top by two horizontal crosspieces, commonly found at the entrance to Shinto temples.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (1) An elevated structure extending across or over the weather deck of a vessel, or part of such a structure. The term is sometimes modified to indicate the intended use, such as navigating bridge or signal bridge. (2) A structure erected over a depression or an obstacle such as a body of water, railroad, etc., to provide a roadway for vehicles or pedestrians.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dam
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A barrier to check or confine anything in motion; particularly one constructed to hold back water and raise its level to form a reservoir, or to prevent flooding.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Ridge Frequency
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the frequency of ice ridges in number per nautical mile.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Ridge Classification
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Describes the predominant type of ridge(s) present.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: New Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A recently formed, comparatively rectilinear conglomeration of ice fragments formed by pressure at the contact line between ice floes, usually along earlier existing cracks and leads or at the boundary between ice floes of different age. In this case, isostatically unbalanced hummocks usually form on the older ice surface. Ice ridges can also form as a result of direct fracturing of ice fields of thick and even first-year and multiyear ice at very strong pressures. The underwater portion of a ridge is termed an ice keel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Weathered Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ridge with peaks slightly rounded and slope of sides usually 30 to 40 degrees. Individual fragments are not discernible.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Very Weathered Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ridge with tops very rounded, slope of sides usually 20-30 degrees.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aged Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A ridge which has undergone considerable weathering. These ridges are best described as undulations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Consolidated Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An ice ridge in which the base has frozen together.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated elevation of varying complexity and size, generally having steep sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ridged Ice Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which much ridged ice with similar characteristics has formed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ridge Barrier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ridge barrier.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Mine Threat Density
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The estimated density of mines.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Shoreline Construction
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of shoreline construction based on use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breakwater
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure protecting a shore area, harbour, anchorage, or basin from waves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Groyne
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low artificial wall-like structure of durable material extending from the land to seaward for a particular purpose, such as to protect the coast or to force a current to scour a channel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A form of breakwater alongside which vessels may lie on the sheltered side only; in some cases it may lie entirely within an artificial harbour, permitting vessels to lie along both sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pier (Jetty)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long, narrow structure extending into the water to afford a berthing place for vessels, to serve as a promenade, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Promenade Pier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pier built only for recreational purposes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure serving as a berthing place for vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Training Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wall or bank, often submerged, built to direct or confine the flow of a river or tidal current, or to promote a scour action.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rip Rap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A layer of broken rock, cobbles, boulders, or fragments of sufficient size to resist the erosive forces of flowing water and wave action.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Revetment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Facing of stone or other material, either permanent or temporary, placed along the edge of a stream, river or canal to stabilize the bank and to protect it from the erosive action of the stream.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sea Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An embankment or wall for protection against waves or tidal action along a shore or water front.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Landing Steps
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Steps at the shoreline as the connection between land and water on different levels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ramp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (1) A sloping structure which may include rails that can either be used, as a landing place, at variable water levels, for small vessels, landing ships, or a ferry boat, or for hauling a cradle carrying a vessel. (2) An accumulation of snow that forms an inclined plane between land or land ice elements and sea ice or ice shelf. Also called drift ice foot.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slipway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The prepared and usually reinforced inclined surface on which keel- and bilge-blocks are laid for supporting a vessel under construction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fender
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A protective structure designed to cushion the impact of a vessel and prevent damage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solid Face Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf consisting of a solid wall of concrete, masonry, wood etc., such that the water cannot circulate freely under the wharf. The type of construction affects ship-handling; for example, a solid face wharf may give shelter from tidal streams, but under certain circumstances a cushion of water may build up between such a wharf and a ship attempting to berth at it, causing difficulties in ship handling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Open Face Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf supported on piles or other structures which allow free circulation of water under the wharf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Log Ramp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inclined plane used to dump logs into the water for transport, or to haul logs out of the water for processing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swimming Facility
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An artificial pool or swimming enclosure, especially one in the open air, which may be constructed of wire mesh or heavy netting supported by cables, buoys or piles, for swimming in.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Quay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf approximately parallel to the shoreline and accommodating ships on one side only, the other side being attached to the shore. It is usually of solid construction, as contrasted with the open pile construction usually used for piers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tie-Up Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A section of wall designated for tying-up vessels awaiting transit. Bollards and mooring devices are available for both large and small ships.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Artificial Obstacle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Man-made structure that acts as an obstacle to landing operations.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: File Locator
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The location of a fragment of text or other information in a support file.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Product
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The various substances which are transported, stored or exploited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Oil
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A thick, slippery liquid that will not dissolve in water, usually petroleum based in the context of storage tanks.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gas
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A substance with particles that can move freely, usually a fuel substance in the context of storage tanks.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A colourless, odourless, tasteless liquid that is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A general term for rock and rock fragments ranging in size from pebbles and gravel to boulders or large rock masses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A hard black mineral that is burned as fuel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ore
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A solid rock or mineral from which metal is obtained.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chemicals
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any substance obtained by or used in a chemical process.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Drinking Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Water that is suitable for human consumption.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Milk
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A white fluid secreted by female mammals as food for their young.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bauxite
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mineral from which aluminum is obtained.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coke
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A solid substance obtained after gas and tar have been extracted from coal, used as a fuel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Iron Ingots
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An oblong lump of cast iron metal.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Salt
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sodium chloride obtained from mines or by the evaporation of sea water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sand
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Loose material consisting of small but easily distinguishable, separate grains, between 0.0625 and 2.000 millimetres in diameter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Timber
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wood prepared for use in building or carpentry.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sawdust/Wood Chips
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Powdery fragments of wood made in sawing timber or coarse chips produced for use in manufacturing pressed board.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Scrap Metal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Discarded metal suitable for being reprocessed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquefied Natural Gas
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Natural gas that has been liquefied for ease of transport by cooling the gas to -162 Celsius.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquefied Petroleum Gas
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A compressed gas consisting of flammable light hydrocarbons and derived from petroleum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wine
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The fermented juice of grapes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cement
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A substance made of powdered lime and clay, mixed with water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Grain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A small hard seed, especially that of any cereal plant such as wheat, rice, corn, rye etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Electricity
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Electric charge or current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The solid form of water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Clay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (Particles of less than 0.002mm); stiff, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solid Fuel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Solid fuel: material wherein the particles firmly cohere; is hard and compact; and is burnt as a source of heat or power.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flammable Liquids And Gases
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Flammable liquids and gases: a substance which is either; in a state where molecules move freely about one another but do not fly apart; or in a condition in which it has no definite boundaries or fixed volume; but which is combustible under normal atmospheric conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ferrous Elements And Ores
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ferrous elements and ores: unrefined and refined: a chemically inseparable substance or solid naturally occurring mineral aggregate, from which one or more valuable constituents may be recovered by treatment or a manufacturing process, and which does contain iron in its trivalent form.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Non Ferrous Elements And Ores
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Non ferrous elements and ores: unrefined and refined: A chemically inseparable substance or solid naturally occurring mineral aggregate, from which one or more valuable constituents may be recovered by treatment or a manufacturing process, and which does not contain iron in its trivalent form.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Metal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Constructed from metal.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Minerals
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Substances produced by a process of in-organic nature; a substance neither animal or vegetable. Normally obtained by mining.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fertiliser
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Natural and Chemical: a substance added to the soil to increase its productivity. It may be produced by or pertaining to nature; not the work of man; or which may be formed from a substance or resulting from a reaction involving changes to atoms or molecules.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wood
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unprocessed and Products: the substance of trees. In unprocessed form, the wood has not undergone change by a method of manufacture into products, being the manufacture of goods or commodities from wood.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rubber
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unprocessed and Products: Strong waterproof elastic material, originally made from the dried sap of a tropical tree, now usually synthetic. In unprocessed form, the rubber has not undergone change by a method of manufacture into products, being the manufacture of goods or commodities from rubber.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Natural Fibers And Materials In General
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unprocessed and Products: that out of which anything is or may be made, produced by or pertaining to nature; not the work of man. A fibre being a filament or thread-like cell of animal, vegetable or mineral. In unprocessed form, the fibre or material has not undergone change by a method of manufacture into products, being the manufacture of goods or commodities from fibre or material.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solid Foodstuffs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any substance that a living thing feeds on, that nourishes the body; sustains or promotes growth, wherein the particles firmly cohere. Some foodstuffs may be consumed unprocessed, while others may undergo one or more manufacturing processes to make it palatable, or to allow mixing with other foodstuffs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid Foodstuffs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any substance that a living thing feeds on, that nourishes the body; sustains or promotes growth, which is in a state where molecules move freely about one another but do not fly apart. Some foodstuffs may be consumed unprocessed, while others may undergo one or more manufacturing processes to make it palatable, or to allow mixing with other foodstuffs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Preserved Foodstuffs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any substance that a living thing feeds on, that nourishes the body; sustains or promotes growth which has been subjected to a process which prevents it from decaying.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: General And Mixed Goods
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Items relating to the whole or most; not specialized; of broad overall character. Mixed; characterized by scope or variety; items combined or associated.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Granular Or Powdery Material
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Physical matter consisting of a relatively small and hard, but usually separate particles; or in a form which is dusty or easily crumbled into tiny, loose particles.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Machinery And Mechanical Parts
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Machinery; apparatus usually powered by electricity designed to perform a specific task. Mechanical parts; components of vehicles or machines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Construction Materials
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: That out of which anything is, or may be made; equipment or implements. Parts that may be put together.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vehicles
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A means of conveyance or transport especially a structure with wheels in or on which people or things are transported by land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aircraft
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Structure or machine for travelling in the air.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Railway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rail or set of parallel rails on which a train, tram, or rail wagon runs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Portable Buildings
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Movable structures for giving shelter, normally prefabricated.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Containers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Boxes for cargo transport with standardized dimensions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Electronics
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Devices based on the technology of the conduction of electricity in a vacuum, gas or a semiconductor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Plastic
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Constructed from plastic.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Paint
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Colouring matter, especially in liquid form for imparting colour to a surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuse And Waste
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Refuse; matter or materials rejected as fit only to be thrown out or away. Waste; material produced during or left over from, a manufacturing process and which is not usable for the main purpose of manufacture, but may be usable for some other purpose or in another operation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radioactive Material
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Relating to, caused by or exhibiting radioactivity; emission of radian elements capable of spontaneously emitting alpha, beta or sometimes gamma rays by the disintegration of the nuclei of atoms

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Armament
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Military weapons, a total means of making war; defensive equipment

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Personnel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: People in general.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Animals And Birds
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Animals; organisms having life, sensation and voluntary movement, which require predominantly land or sea conditions for survival. Birds; warm blooded, egg laying, feathered vertebrates of the class Aves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fish
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vertebrate cold blooded animal with gills, living in water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shellfish And Crustaceans
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Shelled aquatic invertebrates.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ballast
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Material carried by a ship to ensure its stability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diesel Oil
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Diesel oil available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Petrol or Gasoline
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Flammable liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in internal-combustion engines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passengers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Persons travelling in a means of transport operated by others.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Existence of Restricted Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indication that a restricted area exists around the object.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Installation Buoy
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of fixed installation buoy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Catenary Anchor Leg Mooring
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Incorporates a large buoy which remains on the surface at all times and is moored by 4 or more anchors. Mooring hawsers and cargo hoses lead from a turntable on top of the buoy, so that the buoy does not turn as the ship swings to wind and stream.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Single Buoy Mooring
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large mooring buoy used by tankers to load and unload in port approaches or in offshore oil and gas fields.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Ridge Maximum Height
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the maximum height of ice ridge(s) in decimetres.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Moire Effect
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A short range (up to 2km) type of directional light. Sodium lighting gives a yellow background to a screen on which a vertical black line will be seen by an observer on the centre line.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Type of Wreck
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: An indication of the type and / or usage of the vessel before it became a wreck.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Harbour Facility
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of harbour use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: RoRo Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal for roll-on roll-off ferries.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ferry Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal for passenger and vehicle ferries.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fishing Harbour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A harbour with facilities for fishing boats.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yacht Harbour/Marina
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A harbour facility for small boats, yachts, etc., where supplies, repairs, and various services are available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Naval Base
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A centre of operations for naval vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tanker Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal for the bulk handling of liquid cargoes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passenger Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal for the loading and unloading of passengers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shipyard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where ships are built or repaired.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Container Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal with facilities to load/unload or store shipping containers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bulk Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A terminal for the handling of bulk materials such as iron ore, coal, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ship Lift
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A platform powered by synchronous electric motors (for example syncrolift) used to lift vessels (larger than boats) in and out of the water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Straddle Carrier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wheeled vehicle designed to lift and carry containers or vessels within its own framework. It is used for moving, and sometimes stacking, shipping containers and vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Service Harbour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A harbour within which the floating equipment (dredges, tugs ...) of harbour services are stationed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pilotage Service
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The services of a person who directs the movements of a vessel through pilot waters, usually a person who has demonstrated extensive knowledge of channels, aids to navigation, dangers to navigation, etc., in a particular area and is licensed for that area, are available.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Light
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of different light types.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Leading Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light associated with other lights so as to form a leading line to be followed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aero Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An aero light is established for aeronautical navigation and may be of higher power than marine lights and visible from well offshore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flood Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A broad beam light used to illuminate a structure or area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strip Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light whose source has a linear form generally horizontal, which can reach a length of several metres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Subsidiary Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light placed on or near the support of a main light and having a special use in navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spotlight
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A powerful light focused so as to illuminate a small area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Front
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rear
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lower
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Upper
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used with leading lights to describe the position of the light on the lead as viewed from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Emergency
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light available as a backup to a main light which will be illuminated should the main light fail.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bearing Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A light which enables its approximate bearing to be obtained without the use of a compass.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Horizontally Disposed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed horizontally.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vertically Disposed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed vertically.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Technique of Vertical Measurement
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Survey method used to obtain depth information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Echo Sounder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that determines depth of water by measuring the time interval between emission of a sonic or ultrasonic signal and return of its echo from the bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Side Scan Sonar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was computed from a record produced by active sonar in which fixed acoustic beams are directed into the water perpendicularly to the direction of travel to scan the seabed and generate a record of the seabed configuration.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Multi Beam
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using a wide swath echo sounder that uses multiple beams to measure depths directly below and transverse to the ship's track.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by a person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Lead Line
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using a line, graduated with attached marks and fastened to a sounding lead.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Laser
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using an instrument that measures distance by emitting timed pulses of laser light and measuring the time between emission and reception of the reflected pulses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swept by Vertical Acoustic System
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area has been swept using a system comprised of multiple echo sounder transducers attached to booms deployed from the survey vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Electromagnetic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using an instrument that compares electromagnetic signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Photogrammetry
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The science or art of obtaining reliable measurements from photographs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Satellite Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using instruments placed aboard an artificial satellite.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Levelling
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using levelling techniques to find the elevation of the point relative to a datum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swept by Side Scan Sonar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a side scan sonar.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by LIDAR
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that measures distance by emitting timed pulses of laser light and measuring the time between emission and reception of the reflected pulses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Synthetic Aperture Radar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar with a synthetic aperture antenna which is composed of a large number of elementary transducing elements. The signals are electronically combined into a resulting signal equivalent to that of a single antenna of a given aperture in a given direction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hyperspectral Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used to describe the imagery derived from subdividing the electromagnetic spectrum into very narrow bandwidths. These narrow bandwidths may be combined with or subtracted from each other in various ways to form images useful in precise terrain or target analysis.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mechanically Swept
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a line or object below the surface at the desired depth; or least depth(s) and position(s) within an area was identified using the same technique.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Advisory Code
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The Ice Advisory Code describes hazardous ice conditions that may impair navigation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Ice Rafting Concentration
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Describes the concentration of ice rafting in an ice area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Less than one tenth concentration (aerial coverage) of snow-covered ice in an ice area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: No Keels
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Absence of ice keels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Undetermined/Unknown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having an unknown value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximum Flight Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A maximum surface of constant atmospheric pressure which is related to a specific pressure datum, (1,013.2 hectopascal (hPa) or 29.92 inches) and is separated from the consecutive flight levels by a pressure interval corresponding to 500 feet (152.4 m.)

S100FC:uom.S100Base:name: foot
S100FC:uom.S100Base:definition: a unit of length equal to 12 inches, 1/6 of a fathom, or 30.480 centimetres

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Lateral Mark
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of lateral marks in the IALA Buoyage System.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Port-Hand Lateral Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Indicates the port boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the "conventional direction of buoyage".

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Starboard-Hand Lateral Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Indicates the starboard boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the "conventional direction of buoyage".

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Preferred Channel to Starboard Lateral Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: At a point where a channel divides, when proceeding in the "conventional direction of buoyage", the preferred channel (or primary route) is indicated by a modified port-hand lateral mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Preferred Channel to Port Lateral Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: At a point where a channel divides, when proceeding in the "conventional direction of buoyage", the preferred channel (or primary route) is indicated by a modified starboard-hand lateral mark.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Height/Length Units
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Units of measure of waterway distances.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Feet
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A unit of length equal to 12 inches, 1/6 of a fathom, or 30.480 centimetres.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Comparison Operator
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Numerical comparison.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Greater Than
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The value of the left value is greater than that of the right.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Greater Than or Equal To
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The value of the left expression is greater than or equal to that of the right.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Less Than
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The value of the left expression is less than that of the right.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Less Than or Equal To
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The value of the left expression is less than or equal to that of the right.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Equal To
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The two values are equivalent.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Not Equal To
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The two values are not equivalent.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Depth Contour
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The depth of a sea bottom contour.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Periodic Date Range
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The active period of a recurring event or occurrence.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Horizontal Clearance Fixed
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The horizontal clearance measured between two points for a fixed span.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Spatial Accuracy
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Provides an indication of the vertical and horizontal positional uncertainty of bathymetric data, optionally within a specified date range.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Zone of Confidence
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The overall indication of the quality of bathymetric data within an area based on the positional accuracy, survey equipment and coverage; optionally within a specified data range.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Feature Name
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Provides the name of an entity, defines the national language of the name, and provides the option to display the name at various system display settings.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Security Information
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Security information pertaining to organisations and owner authority.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Sector Characteristics
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Describes the characteristics of a light sector.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Clearance Safe
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The safe vertical clearance of a feature measured from the horizontal plane towards the feature overhead.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Direction Heading
